mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 63 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park with clear skies. The air quality index is 51, and we have a first quarter moon tonight. If you are up early, look south toward Belleville at 3:23 AM to spot the International Space Station as it travels toward Fitchburg, staying low near the horizon.

The City of Verona has two important updates. First, the Public Works department is hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects through September 20. Additionally, the city is reminding residents about the rain barrel rebate program, where you can earn a 30 dollar credit on your utility bill for installing a qualifying 35-gallon rain barrel.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol Square or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident from Friday, August 15, where a 44-year-old driver was arrested for an O W I after being found unresponsive in her vehicle near North Main Street.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Raspberry Cheesecake.
